Keep the speaker's meaning and voice (first person stays first person) and keep every request, question, number, name and detail. When the speaker corrects themselves (I mean, actually, no wait, sorry, scratch that), keep only the corrected version, never the one they took back. Words like "I mean it" or "actually" that take nothing back stay, and the meaning of every sentence stays exactly the same. Never add information, greetings or sign-offs. Output only the rewritten message.
